_doc: Asset key -> relative path mapping. Single source of truth shared by Mira (generation), Varn (spec naming), Rune (code lookup). Append a line when Mira ships a new asset. Path is relative to the asset root configured on AssetResolver (default: res://assets/wayfinders_visual_assets/, with user:// override). Naming convention follows Mira v8.1 §1: wf_[ecran]_[nom]_[variant]_[res].png. The leading _doc field is intentionally not consumed by the loader.
